purpose: Generate bounded8bar MIDI candidates from the actual saved pitch/rhythm encoder, without training or dataset role changes
sampling: one shared past8interleaved pitch/rhythm history; independent task-conditioned draws for next interval and gap; mask out-of-range intervals and gap exceeding remaining bar budget; append sampled pair; no beam search, retries or seed selection

copy_screen.references: all128training families full first2048highest-onset projections; exact pinned source hashes/rights; no heldout/reserve references
copy_screen.limitations: bounded heuristic, not legal clearance or guarantee of originality; does not cover all historical editions or transformations

output_policy: retain all3candidate traces and guardresults privately; export MIDI only if structural and fixed similarity checks pass; no retries if blocked
limitations: sample constraints alter raw model distribution
synthetic primer not a learned whole-song structure
no fresh evaluation or learned longform structure claim
MIDI is for private audition,not publication
rng: std::mt19937(seed); one uint32/2^32 cumulative draw per task, ascending labels, pitch then rhythm, including terminal un-emitted nextpitch
